# smc_contact_address (Resource)

This represents a List of single contact address elements, which can be either dynamic or static IP addresses.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `contact_addresses` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--contact_addresses))
- `from_ref` (String) parent href of this sub-resource
- `id` (String) this attribute is the identifier of terraform resource

<a id="nestedblock--contact_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_addresses`

Optional:

- `address` (String) The address associated with this contact address element, typically an IP address.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Indicates whether the contact address element is dynamic, meaning it can change over time.
- `location_ref` (String) This represents the definition of a Location, which keeps a list of Network Elements belonging to the same location.
